mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.total_calories), 0) AS total_calories, COALESCE(SUM(d.total_protein_g), 0) AS total_protein_g, COALESCE(SUM(d.total_carbs_g), 0) AS total_carbs_g, COALESCE(SUM(d.total_fat_g), 0) AS total_fat_g, COALESCE(SUM(d.total_sodium_mg), 0) AS total_sodium_mg, COALESCE(SUM(d.total_fiber_g), 0) AS total_fiber_g, hp.target_calories, hp.target_protein_g, hp.target_carbs_g, hp.target_fat_g, hp.target_sodium_mg FROM users u LEFT JOIN health_profiles hp ON hp.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN diets d ON d.user_id = u.user_id AND d.eaten_at >= #{startAt} AND d.eaten_at < #{endAt} WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY hp.target_calories, hp.target_protein_g, hp.target_carbs_g, hp.target_fat_g, hp.target_sodium_mg
